name: SEO Content Strategy Manager
author: منصة ناس للحلول الرقمية

sections.description:
SEO Content Strategy Manager transforms your WordPress dashboard into a professional SEO command center. Unlike standard SEO plugins that focus on on-page optimization (meta tags, schemas), this plugin focuses on Site Architecture, Content Strategy, and Topical Authority.

Stop guessing about your site’s health. Use AI to analyze your content’s purpose, visualize how your pages link together, and ensure you are covering every stage of the user journey (Awareness, Consideration, Decision).

🚀 Why You Need This Plugin?

  • Link Structure Visualization: See your site like Google sees it. Identify isolated “orphan” pages and strengthen your internal linking.
  • Automated Strategy: It doesn’t just list data; it gives you a Strategic Action Plan based on your unique content mix.
  • AI-Powered Insights: Integrates with Groq to automatically understand the “Search Intent” behind your keywords.
  • Cluster Builder: Easily organize your content into “Hub & Spoke” clusters to boost topical authority.

🔥 Key Features

1. 📊 Interactive Marketing Funnel Analysis (New!)

Automatically categorizes your content into the 3 stages of the marketing funnel using AI:
* TUFO (Top of Funnel): Awareness content (Why, What, How).
* MOFO (Middle of Funnel): Consideration content (Best vs, Comparisons).
* POFO (Bottom of Funnel): Conversion content (Buy, Pricing, Services).
* Visual Dashboard: See a live funnel visualization of your site’s balance.
* Smart Recommendations: Get specific advice (e.g., “Create more Comparison pages”) if your funnel is unbalanced.

2. 🕸️ Visual Link Graph & Architecture

  • Interactive Graph: A dynamic node-link diagram showing how all your posts connect.
  • Orphan Detection: Instantly spot pages that have zero internal links pointing to them.
  • Topic Grouping: Nodes are colored by category, making it easy to spot content silos.

3. 🎯 Keyword Cannibalization Detector

  • Instant Alerts: Finds multiple posts targeting the same Focus Keyword (from Rank Math or Yoast).
  • Fix It Fast: deciding which post should keep the keyword and which should be modified.

4. 🧠 AI Search Intent Classification

  • Auto-Tagging: Automatically tags your keywords as Informational, Commercial, Transactional, or Navigational.
  • API Support: Supports Groq for ultra-fast analysis.

5. 🔗 Content Clusters (Hub & Spoke)

  • Cluster Management: Designate “Pillar” pages and assign “Spoke” articles to them.
  • Smart Link Suggestions: Scans your content for unlinked mentions of your Pillar keywords and suggests internal links instantly.

6. 📉 Content Audit & Health

  • Missing Focus Keywords: Quickly find posts that haven’t been optimized yet.
  • Entity Tracking: Monitor specific entities or topics across your entire site.
  • Health Score: Get a 0-100 score on your overall content strategy health.

🌐 Third-Party Services & Privacy

This plugin integrates with third-party AI services to provide keyword analysis and marketing funnel classification. Use of these services is optional and requires a manual action by the site administrator.

  • Groq API (Groq Cloud)
    • Service URL: https://console.groq.com/
    • Purpose: High-speed processing for search intent analysis and marketing funnel categorization.
    • What Data is Sent: Only focus keywords and titles.
    • When Data is Sent: Only on manual administrator request.
    • Terms of Service: Groq Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy: Groq Privacy Policy

🔒 Data Privacy & User Tracking

  • No User Tracking: This plugin does not track users, collect telemetry, or “phone home” to our servers.
  • No Visitor Data Collection: This plugin does not collect or store any data from your website visitors.
  • Local Processing: All internal linking analysis and site architecture processing happen locally on your WordPress server.

📚 Third-Party Libraries

  • Vis.js Network (Used for Visual Link Graph)
    • Source: https://github.com/visjs/vis-network
    • License: Apache 2.0 / MIT

🛠️ Compatibility

  • SEO Plugins: Fully compatible with Rank Math and Yoast SEO (pulls focus keywords automatically).
  • Editors: Works with Gutenberg, Classic Editor, Elementor, and others.
  • Post Types: Supports Posts, Pages, and Custom Post Types (configurable).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seo-content-strategy-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Focus Keywords menu item in your dashboard.
  4. (Optional) Go to Settings to enter your Groq API key for AI features.
  5. Run a “Scan” to analyze your current content.
sections.faq:
Q: Do I need Rank Math or Yoast SEO installed?

A: While not strictly required, it is highly recommended. The plugin is designed to analyze the “Focus Keywords” you set in those plugins. Without them, you will need to manually enter keywords for analysis.

Q: Is the AI feature free?

A: The plugin itself includes the integration code. You will need your own API Key. Groq currently offers a very generous free beta tier affecting specific models.

Q: What is “TUFO”, “MOFO”, and “POFO”?

A: These stand for Top, Middle, and Bottom of the Funnel. A healthy website needs a balance of all three:
* TUFO: Attracts new traffic (Guides).
* MOFO: Helps users evaluate options (Reviews).
* POFO: Drives sales/leads (Landing Pages).

Q: Does this plugin slow down my site?

A: No. The analysis runs in the admin dashboard and uses custom database tables and caching (transients) to store results. It does not load any scripts or impact the performance of your front-end website.

Q: Can I visualize Custom Post Types (like Products)?

A: Yes! You can configure which Post Types to include in the analysis from the settings page.

Q: How does the “Smart Link Suggestions” work?

A: It looks at your “Pillar” pages and their focus keywords. Then, it scans all other “Spoke” pages to see if they mention those keywords without linking to the Pillar. If found, it suggests adding a link.

Q: Does the plugin collect personal user data?

A: No. Groq only analyze the focus keywords from posts/pages when manually triggered by the site administrator. No personal user data is collected.
